factions.name: Iron Covenant
factions.identity: Noble houses and sworn orders. Few, elite, armoured knights who win in melee.
factions.doctrine: Sworn Knights: each Driver trait costs 1 point less.

factions.name: Ashen Foundries
factions.identity: Industrial warbands and mercenary legions. Cheap, tough gun walkers in numbers.
factions.doctrine: Forge Plate: Ablative Plating costs 1 point less.

factions.name: Reliquary
factions.identity: A forgotten order of relic machines. Frail, fast or strange, with one towering Goliath.
factions.doctrine: From the Veil: deploy one war-walker after the enemy has finished deploying.
